kjv: commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt
mine: commanded Moses. The Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt were:
note: The Hebrew can be read as "Moses and the Israelites" as joint objects of the command, or (as the list that follows suggests) as a heading introducing the census of "the Israelites who came out of Egypt".
Hebrew Serach (with chet) is a different name from Sarah (Sarah with he); the KJV spells it Serah in Gen 46:17 and 1 Chr 7:30.
